newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 9.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:
* The Academy Awards may move their ceremony to one of two sites in southern California, and may reschedule the show to Sunday instead of Monday.
* House Speaker Newt Gingrich said he supports efforts to set aside one hour of primetime for programming free from sex or violence.

* Sony Corp's entertainment business group , which encompasses its film and music operations, posted its earnings for the fiscal year ending March 31, showing it benefited by the yen's 15 percent decline against the dollar over the past year.
* Millenium Films, a newcomer to filmmaking, will be bringing a host of movies to Cannes to be sold just a year after it started operations.
* Walt Disney Co's Buena Vista International has sold all non-English-speaking country rights of "The Deedles," a summer 1998 release, to Quadra.
* Mike Karz, the vice president of David Hoberman's Mandeville Films, has signed a deal with Walt Disney Television to produce movies and television series.
